counters.notes: The strategy is very simple. All opponents have Taunt, so you can choose who you attack. Avoid attacking Ms. Marvel (Classic) until you eliminate the other opponents. The exception is Falcon Joaquin (Special), which you should use on Kahhori, so if Ms. Marvel (Classic) is next to her then it is inevitable that you hit her. Captain (Sam) Ultimate also hits all opponents, so you can make an exception here as well because it will fill your entire team’s Speed Bar.

One of the best counters for Absolute A-Force is Absolute A-Force. Your Kahhori passively, on Spawn, attacks the opponent Kahhori first, applies Exposed to her and prevents her from playing twice at the start. So the opponent Kahhori will only be able to use Special in her third turn. Focus on Ms. Marvel (Classic) until she loses Taunt. With Kahhori – twice Basic, then in her second turn – Special, with Ms. Marvel (Classic) – Ultimate. When the opponent Ms. Marvel (Classic) loses Taunt, switch your focus to the rest of the opponents. Kahhori’s and Medusa’s Ultimate can deal massive damage and eliminate most of the opposing team. After that, it’s all about bringing the fight to the end. Leave Ms. Marvel (Classic) for last.

With Mephisto, play Empowered Basic on Ms. Marvel (Classic), and with Red Hulk use Special on her. You can use Special with Mephisto on his second turn. When Kahhori plays her Special, Red Hulk will get 5 Charged and will be able to use Ultimate, thus applying his Battlefield Effect to the opponent’s side. Opponents will have all negativities from Mephisto losing Empowered and Red Hulk Ultimate, but most importantly Heal Block, Trauma, and Bleed. After Mephisto plays his Ultimate – you’ll eliminate them without a problem. When Ms. Marvel (Classic) loses Taunt, focus on Kahhori. The Deathproofs you get from Mephisto’s Battlefield Effect and the Brawn’s Passive (as well as Deflects on Spawn) are essential for your team to withstand attacks. If Mephisto and Red Hulk are maxed, massive punch-ups are possible.

With Peggy, use her Special on Ares, and then focus on Odin as your primary target. All other characters should also concentrate on Odin. Use Captain Sam’s Ultimate, Patriot’s Special, and War Machine’s Special to deal damage. If your three new Liberty characters are GT20 (specifically if their Overpower rating is higher than the opponent’s), you should have enough damage to eliminate Odin before his turn. If you don’t have an advantage in Overpower, this counter-strategy is not recommended (but still can work). Once Odin is eliminated, the rest of the battle will become much easier.

This counter works best if your Blade and Oath have a higher Overpower ranking compared to the opponent’s Gladiator and Odin. Start by using Mephisto’s Empowered Basic attack along with his standard Basic attack on Gladiator. With Blade, use his Ultimate ability on Ares (especially if Ares is positioned next to Gladiator – that’s an ideal scenario). Once you’ve taken down the two opposing protectors, shift your full focus to Odin. If you have the Overpower advantage, you should be able to defeat him before he gets a chance to act. However, we don’t recommend using this counter if you lack the Overpower advantage mentioned above.

This is an ideal counter to use if your Orchis characters have a higher Overpower rating compared to the opponent’s Odin and Gladiator. Start by using Mephisto’s Empowered Basic followed by a Basic on Gladiator. With Scientist Supreme, activate her Ultimate. Use Nimrod’s Special ability to target all enemies, and then use Lady Deathstrike’s Special or Basic ability to attack the remaining opponent with Taunt (either Gladiator or Ares). When using Sentinel, activate his Ultimate on Odin and have his minions focus their attacks on Odin as well. This should be enough to eliminate Odin. Afterward, concentrate on defeating the remaining opponents. However, we do not recommend using this counter strategy if your Orchis team does not have an Overpower advantage over Gladiator and Odin.

Use Hela’s Minion (Greg) to attack Gladiator or Ares with his Special. This will reduce the Speed Bar of all opponents except Odin, allowing the enemy Odin to take the first turn. The enemy Odin will use his Special, but he won’t apply his Battlefield Effect because he didn’t assist. Next, use your Odin’s Special. Since your Odin already assisted when Greg attacked, your Odin will successfully apply the Battlefield Effect to the enemy side. This gives you a strong advantage that will be difficult for the opponent to overcome. Thanos (Endgame) can deal significant passive damage when we reduce him below 50% HP, but he won’t be able to eliminate your team. The enemy Odin will eventually use his Ultimate, causing serious damage, but he still won’t apply the Battlefield Effect to your side because he used his Ultimate instead of his Basic attack. With the rest of your team, focus all attacks on the opposing Odin. Once you take him out, you should have no trouble securing victory.

Start with Void Knight’s Ultimate, then use Carnage’s Special. You need to target the Gladiator because he has the Taunt. With Knull, use his Special first, as it will summon an extra Carnage and give you a significant Speed Bar boost when you bring any opponent’s health down to the red zone. Knull’s next move should be his Ultimate ability. By this point, some enemies should be defeated, and others should have low health. Be cautious of Thanos (Endgame) and his passive damage, as it can create a challenging situation. However, as long as at least one Carnage, Knull, and one other character are still alive, you should be able to win this easily. If your Hive-Mind characters are weak, consider swapping out Gwen for Odin. With Odin on your team, victory becomes much simpler.

Ares is mainly there for his passive abilities. After Ultimus and Gorr take their turns, Ares will most likely be defeated. The key point for you is to ensure that Old Man Logan (OML) gets his turn. Ares will strip all buffs from the enemy team, allowing you to Stun Thanos (Endgame) with OML right at the start of the battle. Focus on taking down Knull as your priority. Use Pandapool’s Ultimate and Daken’s Special, combined with OML’s assist and the damage from his Special, to eliminate Knull quickly. With Deadpool you can Stun Gladiator and after that focus on Gorr and Thanos (Endgame). When Thanos (Endgame) deals passive damage, it’s crucial that both Daken and Old Man Logan have Revive available to sustain the fight.
